name: עִירָד
summary: Irad is the son of Enoch and grandson of Cain, and the father of Mehujael, in the line that ends in Lamech (Gen 4:18). His name begins with the letters of עִיר, and it follows at once on the first city: Cain “was building a city, and called the name of the city after the name of his son Enoch” (Gen 4:17), and to that Enoch Irad was born. Scripture does not explain the name, and the ending ‑ād is not accounted for, so the tie to “city” is no more than likely.

evidence.note: וַיִּוָּלֵד לַחֲנוֹךְ אֶת־עִירָד: “and to Enoch was born Irad, and Irad begot Mehujael”.
The verse before: Cain builds עִיר and names הָעִיר after Enoch, Irad's father.

note: The whole case is the name's first three letters and its place beside Gen 4:17; the reviewer may prefer to leave the name without an entry. The Septuagint reads Γαιδαδ, as from a spelling with ד for ר. A link with the place עֲרָד Arad has been proposed but has no evidence in the text.
